name: research-agent
description: Autonomous research agent that searches, analyzes, and generates reports

capabilities.description: Search the web for relevant information
Synthesize search results into key insights

implementation.system: You are a research analyst. Synthesize information into clear insights.
You are a professional report writer. Create well-structured, citation-rich reports.

capabilities.description: Calculate quality metrics for the report

implementation.code:
report = ws.get('report.content')
word_count = len(report.split())
has_structure = all(section in report.lower() for section in ['summary', 'findings', 'conclusion'])
quality = min(1.0, word_count / 500) * (1.0 if has_structure else 0.5)
return {'quality.score': quality}

goal.description: Research report generated with quality score >= 0.7
